column1: # Title: Building mean lifetime and vintage assumptions (for comm and resid materials sectors)

# Description: Mapping building mean lifetime assumptions from Deetman et al. Using simple assumptions and assuming the same lifetype across all sub-types in a given region.  Deetman do not provide lifetime by subtypes (only Weibull distribution parameters that differ by subtypes for only a few regions: Japan
column3: Eastern Europe). Note that Deetman/IMAGE use Weibull lifetime distribution and a different building floorspace growth function. Here we are simply taking the mean building lifetypes for a subset of aggregate regions and global average (for residential buildings) and global average for commercial buildings. half.life: number of years at which 50% of the base year cohort is retired; using the s-curve-shutdown-decider retirement function. steepness: shape parameter used by the s-curve-shutdown-decider retirement function. median.shutdown.point: profit-ratio at which 50% of the cohort is shut down for lack of profitability. profit.shutdown.steepness: shape parameter of profit-shutdown-decider function.
